entities.summary: Rosa Lobato de Faria was a Portuguese actress and writer whose career encompassed a variety of media including acting, scriptwriting, literature and songwriting. She was a respected figure in Portuguese cultural circles. She was married twice. Her first marriage, which produced three children, ended in divorce.
